items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: He was a real asset at Pat O'Brien's. And, you know, being at Pat O'Brien's all those years... Emile knew every college song in the United States.

ctx.x: He was like this with his talk. He wouldn't give people a chance to say no or anything, man. I mean, they were out on the floor. If nobody was dancing quick enough, Emile would have been dancing in five minutes. He just full of that vim, vigor and vitality, plus personality, plus. And he knew how to liven up the deadest party you ever saw. He could liven it up in five minutes.
He must have been on the day. And he did great at Pat O'Brien's.
